name: journals_in_default_order
note: account.journal search in _order = 'sequence, type, code' (addons/account/models/account_journal.py), the dashboard and journal selectors' order: company, type, code, sequence, active flag and default account of every journal; all rows (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, company_id, type, code, sequence, active, default_account_id FROM account_journal ORDER BY sequence, type, code, id

name: journals_per_company_and_type
note: AccountMove._search_default_journal (addons/account/models/account_move.py:955) searches journals by company and type: journal count per (company, type) with the active ones and the lowest id the default picks, plus reconcile models linked through account_journal_account_reconcile_model_rel (embedded as accountReconcileModelRel)
source_sql: SELECT j.company_id, j.type, count(*) AS journals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.active) AS active_journals, min(j.id) AS first_journal, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_journal_account_reconcile_model_rel r JOIN account_journal j2 ON j2.id = r.account_journal_id WHERE j2.company_id = j.company_id AND j2.type = j.type) AS reconcile_models FROM account_journal j GROUP BY j.company_id, j.type ORDER BY j.company_id, j.type
